mapper.sql: u.user_id AS userId, u.uuid::text AS uuid, u.first_name AS firstName, u.last_name AS lastName, u.username AS username, u.email AS email, CASE WHEN 'ADMIN' = ANY (u.roles) THEN 'admin' ELSE 'client' END AS userType, u.phone_country_code AS phoneCountryCode, u.phone_number AS phoneNumber, u.country AS country, u.risk_appetite AS riskAppetite, u.status AS status, a.account_id AS accountId, a.status AS accountStatus, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, u.created_on AS createdOn, u.approved_on AS approvedOn, u.suspended_on AS suspendedOn, u.rejection_reason AS rejectionReason, NULL::boolean AS emailDelivered
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth.users u LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY u.user_id ASC
SELECT FROM auth.users u LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT FROM auth.users u LEFT JOIN account a ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.status = #{status} ORDER BY u.created_on ASC
SELECT user_id FROM auth.users WHERE uuid = #{uuid}::uuid
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth.users WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE auth.users SET status = #{newStatus}, approved_on = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'ACTIVE' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, approved_by = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'ACTIVE' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, rejected_on = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REJECTED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, rejection_reason = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REJECTED' THEN #{reason} ELSE NULL END, suspended_on = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'SUSPENDED' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, suspended_by = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'SUSPENDED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth.status_change_log (user_id, old_status, new_status, reason, changed_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{reason}, #{actorUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.user_id AS userId, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', COALESCE(u.last_name, '')) AS holderName, u.username AS username, CASE WHEN 'ADMIN' = ANY (u.roles) THEN 'admin' ELSE 'client' END AS userType, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version FROM account a JOIN auth.users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY a.account_id ASC

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.user_id AS userId, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', COALESCE(u.last_name, '')) AS holderName, u.username AS username, CASE WHEN 'ADMIN' = ANY (u.roles) THEN 'admin' ELSE 'client' END AS userType, a.currency AS currency, a.cash_balance AS cashBalance, a.status AS status, a.version AS version FROM account a JOIN auth.users u ON a.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE account SET status = #{status}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CLOSED' THEN now() ELSE closed_at END, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE account SET cash_balance = cash_balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND cash_balance + #{amount} >= 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO balance_adjustment (account_id, amount, reason, adjusted_by) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{actorUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT instrument_id AS instrumentId, symbol, ticker, asset_class AS assetClass, quote_currency AS quoteCurrency, status FROM instrument ORDER BY symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instrument (symbol, ticker, asset_class, quote_currency, status) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{ticker}, #{assetClass}, #{quoteCurrency}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE instrument SET status = #{status}, delisted_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DELISTED' THEN now() ELSE delisted_at END WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
